metadata.title: Analysis code and example data for: Syndrome-Resolved Decoding of Qubit Readout Errors
metadata.description: RED (Readout Error Decoder) is a Python package for decomposing repeated qubit-readout records into assignment, bit-flip, and leakage error channels. This release includes the analysis code, tutorials and raw IQ example datasets from the fluxonium and transmon measurements presented in the main text.
